description: Wind reached ~10 m/s and temperatures dropped to single digits (Celsius) in late July — early signals of approaching Arctic autumn.
response: EVA duration was adjusted and extra layers worn. Incinerator operations were paused until wind direction was favourable.
lesson: Plan weather-exposed and physically demanding work for the earlier part of the mission. Ensure a thermal emergency kit (hand warmers, emergency blankets) is accessible on every EVA. Temperature drops fast in late July on Devon Island.
source_citation: SRC-hypatia-iii-brief, Part IV – Incident and emergency register, §4.2 Meteorological incidents, lines 611-616. Register Crew tag: 'C15'. Sol: not stated; the entry places this 'in late July' and C15's mission spans July 1-31, so sol ~27 is used as a late-July placeholder. Confidence (B) rationale: narrative weather-observation entry; daily-report style.
